integrity: Exact algebra checked with standalone rational and polynomial verifier; scientific assessment is limited to this work, and independent audit and experimental validation were not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a specified two-dimensional OU fluctuation system with symmetric exchange and independent fixed additive noise. Does not model extinction, nonlinear persistence, correlated noise or larger networks; half bound only with noise intensities matched to regulation rates. Closest nonlinear metapopulation research supplies qualitative motivation and covariance methods, not a validation of the exact phase law.
title: A sharp dispersal window for reducing two-patch regional population fluctuations
